# OpenDyslexic

The dyslexia-friendly font offered in the reader's Aa panel (Font: Dyslexic).

- **Files:** regular (400) and bold (700), Latin subset, `woff2`.
- **Source:** Fontsource, `@fontsource/opendyslexic` 5.3.0, from cdn.jsdelivr.net, 24 September 2026.
- **Author:** Abbie Gonzalez (https://opendyslexic.org).
- **License:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, in `LICENSE` beside the fonts. The license allows the
  fonts to be bundled with the site. It requires the license to stay with them and the name
  "OpenDyslexic" to be used only for the unmodified font.

The `@font-face` rules are at the top of `assets/course.css`. A browser downloads a file only when
a student chooses the font. Italic text is slanted by the browser; add the italic files from the
same package if true italics are wanted.
